summary: Kandi Technologies Group, Inc., a British Virgin Islands-incorporated, China-based off-road EV maker, furnished a Form 6-K with unaudited H1 2026 results for the six months ended June 30, 2026. Revenue rose 57.4% year-over-year to $57.1 million, net income reached $9.4 million ($0.10 per diluted share), and gross margin was 43.5%. The filing notes completion of the Rawrr Inc. acquisition in February 2026 under a December 5, 2025 share transfer agreement. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are stated; this is a routine earnings release.
